CustomField.description: When ticked, this account is skipped by the automated at-risk / warm-off offboarding (at-risk task, warm-off emails and 18-month deactivation). On a Company it covers all of its Store Locations. Manual offboarding is not affected.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to keep this account out of the automated at-risk / warm-off offboarding. Manual offboarding still works.
CustomField.label: Exclude from Auto-Offboarding
